shared_setup_scope: Scenario JSON parse and immutable resolution are timed once; provider registration/selection, strategy and selector registries, and prepared membership provider are timed once. These shared setup values are excluded from per-strategy totals.
order_policy: One excluded A-then-B warmup pair; seven measured pairs alternate A/B then B/A. Both members of every pair share this immutable resolved problem and provider registries.
per_strategy_scope: Fresh StrategyRegistry::prepare through exclusive workspace creation, public StrategyPort run and complete-family acceptance, selector preparation/query returning two distinct histories, and witness-only verification of both histories against the original resolved problem. Excludes process startup, shared scenario/provider setup, JSON serialization/file I/O, build, plots and report rendering.

phase_scope.preparation_ns: StrategyRegistry::prepare including capability admission and immutable plan creation
phase_scope.workspace_creation_ns: Prepared strategy create through exclusive workspace return
phase_scope.family_construction_ns: Public workspace run through result return, including the registered exact-profile verifier
phase_scope.selector_preparation_ns: Selector selection/preparation for this strategy result
phase_scope.selector_workspace_creation_ns: Prepared selector create through exclusive query workspace return
phase_scope.witness_query_ns: Selector workspace run and checked batch binding/count
phase_scope.end_to_end_strategy_ns: Preparation start through completion of both original-data witness checks; inclusive total, not a sum of other measured phases

phase_counters_unavailable: Internal LP/convex, projection, affine-sum, conversion, hull-membership and verifier subphase durations/call counts are not exposed by these public APIs.
CPU time and per-call peak memory are not measured by this timing driver.
